files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- **Consistent button border radius, vibrant destructive Delete button, and one-click Reset for ignored empty folders** ([#236](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/236)). Updated `.empty-folders-scan-btn` (`Scan folders`) and `.empty-folders-delete-pill` (`Permanently delete {count} folders`) to use the standard application corner radius (`var(--border-radius-large, 8px)`) instead of pill rounding, aligned the Empty Folders delete button color with the topbar bulk delete button (`#d32f2f` at rest, `#b71c1c` on hover), added a one-click reset button (`.modal-reset-ignored-folders-button` and `.modal-restore-all-ignored-button`) to restore all ignored empty folders at once, and clarified the German translation of `Ignore: {count}` as `Ignorieren: {count}`
